name: NAVTTC Web Development Course
target_group: Youth wanting to become full-stack web developers
summary_en: Free 6-month NVQF Level 4 course covering full-stack web development (front-end, JavaScript, back-end), leading to a nationally and internationally recognized certificate.
summary_ur: 6 ماہ کا مفت کورس جس میں فرنٹ اینڈ، جاوا اسکرپٹ اور بیک اینڈ ڈویلپمنٹ سکھائی جاتی ہے۔

eligibility_conditions.special_quota_note: General NAVTTC youth-programme preference applies; check the specific course listing for any institute-level quota. Basic computer literacy is recommended for this course but is not a stated entry requirement.

required_documents: CNIC (or Form-B for applicants without a full CNIC yet)
application_steps: Browse the Web Development listing on navttc.gov.pk/student
Confirm the course is showing an active 'Apply' status (not 'Show Interest')
Register/apply online at nsis.navttc.gov.pk
Submit CNIC and educational documents as requested
Await confirmation of seat allocation from the training institute
source_title: NAVTTC — Web Development course listing (NVQF Level 4, 6 months, Information Technology sector)
disclaimer: Eligibility details were confirmed against the official source on 2026-09-12. The application deadline shown is a provisional placeholder for the expected cycle, not a date the authority has announced - confirm it on the official page before applying.
